message.abstract: <jats:p>Among all generalized Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes which sample the same invariant measure and for which the same amount of randomness (a $N$-dimensional Brownian motion) is injected in the system, we prove that the asymptotic rate of convergence is maximized by a non-reversible hypoelliptic one.</jats:p>
title: Optimal linear drift for the speed of convergence of an hypoelliptic diffusion
